note: Large forest area west of Marble Hill. This entry's camp is the gravel pull-through loop with about six back-in pads at the multi-use trailhead off Route Y, by the shooting range; MDC's map labels a camping area there 'Horse Camping Area (Trail Head)'. A second camp, Trace Creek Camping Area, is on County Road 822 in the north unit. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites'/'Individual Campsites': free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. GIS has 2 camping points: 35 (= stored pin, a gravel loop with ~6 back-in pads at the trailhead/shooting range, fits a 23-ft rig) and 162 Trace Creek Camping Area 12.8 km north on CR 822 (split proposed). Map labels the trailhead camp 'Horse Camping Area (Trail Head)' - possible horse-camp question flagged. Pin fine; not waterfront kept; phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Open Camping - Walk-in/Float-in/Backpack; Designated Camping Sites; Individual Campsites' and says 'Facilities/features at Castor River CA include primitive camping, multi-use trails for hiking, biking and horse riding'. The stored pin = GIS camping point 35, beside parking lot 1234. On 0.4 m/px leaf-off imagery it's a gravel drive-through loop (~250 m long) with about six back-in gravel pads with tables and a small building, in an open mowed clearing, so a 23-ft rig fits. There's no 4WD note, ford or length limit. The brochure adds walk-in primitive camping 100 yards from roads elsewhere (not this entry).

CRITERIA QUESTION (horse camp?): the 06/15 MDC map shows two Primitive Camping Area symbols at this trailhead. The one SW of the lot carries the label 'Horse Camping Area (Trail Head)', and the other is ~250 m NE; a round gravel loop ~150 m NE of the pads loop shows on imagery. The GIS has a single camping point, at the pads loop. No MDC page restricts camping here to riders, and the area page lists general 'Designated Camping Sites'. But if the pads loop is the horse camp, it's a horse-trailhead camp, so AWH to decide. Map scale (~17 m/px at 120 dpi) can't separate the two symbols with confidence.

SPLIT PROPOSED: Trace Creek Camping Area, GIS camping point 162 at 37.29757,-90.18245 (in woods), with the gravel loop beside parking lot 2240 at 37.29652,-90.18145. It's 12.8 km north of the pin in the north unit, on its own road (County Road 822, labelled on the MDC map 'Trace Creek Camping Area'), versus Route Y / the shooting-range road for this entry. Suggested pin on the gravel loop at ~37.2966,-90.1818. Fit not verified beyond imagery: a gravel loop off the county road, wide enough to turn.
PIN: stored 37.18323,-90.15495 = GIS camping point 35, on the pads loop - fine.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): upland forest; the Castor River is ~1 km+ away.
